notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-sT (Connect scan) completes the full TCP three-way handshake. Unlike SYN scan, does not require root privileges — falls back to this automatically when Nmap runs without sudo. More accurate but noisier than -sS.

=== vs SYN SCAN ===
SYN (-sS): half-open, never completes handshake, requires root, faster, less logged. Connect (-sT): full handshake, no root needed, slower, systems log completed connections, IDS/IPS detects readily.

=== USE CASE ===
Needed when: no root access, scanning from restricted environment, full-connection accuracy required. Port 443 example: testing HTTPS service with a complete connection to verify the service responds.
